hog_spot_price.eval_en: Hog prices trade below 10 CNY/kg, exerting negative supply-side drag on Food CPI.
hog_spot_price.eval_zh: 生猪成交均价跌破10元/公斤，养殖端深度亏损，对食品CPI形成持续负向拖累。

veg_basket_200.eval_en: Wholesale vegetable supply remains ample, easing holiday price spikes.
veg_basket_200.eval_zh: 菜篮子200指数位于历史中低分位，秋季蔬菜供给充足，平抑节后价格异动。

agri_wholesale_index.eval_en: Agricultural wholesale benchmark shows balanced food pipeline transmission.
agri_wholesale_index.eval_zh: 农产品批发价格指数企稳，食品端输入性通胀压力极低。

pmi_price_indices.eval_en: Factory gate output price DI remains in contraction (<50), indicating downstream pricing power weakness.
pmi_price_indices.eval_zh: 制造业出厂价格指数持续低于荣枯线(47.8)，中下游缺乏提价动力，工业利润空间收窄。

capacity_utilization.eval_en: Manufacturing capacity utilization at 75.1% keeps factory gate price pressures subdued.
capacity_utilization.eval_zh: 制造业产能利用率在75.1%偏低区间运行，上游供给充裕压制出厂价格弹性。
